Rahul Gandhi Claims Election Commission Leaks Information

Congress leader Rahul Gandhi claimed that information is being leaked from within the Election Commission, stating that "this structure will not last much longer." He also asserted that Indian democracy is "sacred" and that boycotting elections would lead to its end.
